title: Claude Cowork
content:
## Overview

**Claude Cowork** is Anthropic's desktop product for open-ended knowledge work, distinct from the Claude.ai chat interface and from Claude Code. Where a chat is a back-and-forth conversation, Cowork is a **working session**: you describe a goal, Claude plans and executes a multi-step task against your local files, folders, and desktop applications, and you can steer mid-task or step away and come back to a finished deliverable — a formatted document, an organized folder, a synthesized research summary.

---

## What Makes It Different From Chat and Claude Code

| | Claude.ai Chat | Claude Code | Claude Cowork |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary surface | Conversation | Terminal/IDE, codebase | Desktop app, local files & apps |
| Interaction model | One prompt, one reply | Agentic coding loop | Long-running task, steerable mid-execution |
| Target user | General Q&A | Developers | Non-technical knowledge workers (research, ops, legal, finance) |
| Output | Text/chat | Code, commits | Documents, organized files, reports |

Cowork runs **on the desktop** rather than in an isolated cloud container, so it can move between local applications and files directly — the tradeoff Claude Code's cloud sessions make in the other direction (ephemeral, isolated, git-mediated) for reproducibility and safety.

---

## Who It's For

 Anthropic pitches Cowork at people whose workday includes tasks that are **time-consuming but not technically complex**: researchers, analysts, operations and legal teams, finance teams — anyone who spends real time assembling documents and data who would rather spend that time on judgment calls than on the assembly work itself. This is also reflected in Claude Code's own onboarding, which now offers role-based setup (e.g., "Legal", "paralegal") pointing at plugins tailored for non-engineering knowledge work.

---

## Availability and Integration

- Available on **all paid plans** through the Claude desktop app.
- Named alongside Claude Platform, Claude.ai, and Claude Code as one of the surfaces that regained access to **Fable 5** when its export-control suspension was lifted on July 1, 2026 (see the Claude 5 Family page) — confirming Cowork sits on the same model backend and release cadence as Anthropic's other first-party products rather than being a separate model tier.

---

## Why It Matters

Cowork represents Anthropic's push of agentic, tool-using Claude beyond software engineering (Claude Code's domain) into general desktop knowledge work — the same underlying agentic capabilities (planning, multi-step execution, tool use over local resources) repackaged for a much larger, non-developer audience. It's a useful data point for where Anthropic sees the largest near-term market for autonomous agents: not just "write code" but "produce a finished business deliverable, unattended."
